name: raw
meaning: PS1-style receive buffer (34 bytes on the PS1: prev starts at 0x22); only the first 8 used. Filled by Pad_ReadRaw

name: prev
meaning: previous latched frame; struct-copied from cur by Pad_Latch (0x55eff1)

name: cur
meaning: current latched frame; struct-copied from raw by Pad_Latch (0x55f003)

name: menuCur
meaning: = g_padMenuCur 0x71965a: raw.buttons with the stick folded in as d-pad bits (Pad_AnalogToDpadBits 0x55f24e)

name: menuPrev
meaning: = g_padMenuPrev 0x71965c: previous menuCur (0x55f240)

name: btnRepeat
meaning: Pad_AutoRepeat state for cur.buttons (0x55efda)

name: menuRepeat
meaning: Pad_AutoRepeat state for menuCur; output +0x40 = g_padMenuRepeat 0x719668 (0x55f313)

name: state44
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState and on every analog Pad_DetectType; no reader found

name: state48
meaning: cleared with +0x44; no reader found

name: state4c
meaning: cleared with +0x44; no reader found

name: state50
meaning: set to 0x1000 (1.0 in 4.12) by Pad_ResetState

name: state54
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState / analog detect

name: padType
meaning: controller type id: 4 digital (keyboard/digital device), 7 analog; source of the raw type nibble

name: padTypeReq
meaning: written alongside +0x57 (4/7); Input_Init tests == 7 to set +0x5b

name: state59
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState (0x55ee33) and analog detect (0x55e4aa); no reader found

name: state5a
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState (0x55ee3a) and analog detect (0x55e4b1); no reader found

name: actuatorEnable
meaning: set 1 by Input_Init when +0x58 == 7, cleared on pause open and on every analog Pad_DetectType, restored from Progress+0x9b on pause exit; write-only in this exe (rumble is stubbed). Probably vibration enable

name: state5c
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState (0x55ee41); no reader found

name: state5d
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState (0x55ee48); no reader found

name: state60
meaning: cleared by Pad_ResetState / analog detect
